description: This file is a shell script that defines functions for manipulating git repository states, such as setting and verifying file contents in the worktree and index, and saving/retrieving commit heads.

methods.name: set_state
methods.description: Prepares the specified file in the worktree and index with given content.

methods.name: save_state
methods.description: Saves the current content of a file in the worktree and index to editor files.

methods.name: set_and_save_state
methods.description: Sets the state of a file and then saves it.

methods.name: verify_state
methods.description: Verifies that the file content matches expected contents in the worktree and index.

methods.name: verify_saved_state
methods.description: Verifies that the saved state matches the current state in the worktree and index.

methods.name: save_head
methods.description: Saves the current HEAD revision ID.

methods.name: verify_saved_head
methods.description: Compares the current HEAD revision ID to the saved one.
